confidence_semantics: Relationships do not calculate probability, strength, rank, or confidence and do not change a RuleResult confidence category.
evidence_boundary: The service consumes completed RuleResult objects only. It does not read raw files, recompute metrics, or change rule statuses.
limitations: R1/R2 conflict records competing candidate interpretations and does not select one.
R1/R4 corroboration records compatible context only and does not increase confidence.
R0 suppression is activated only by its explicit blocked_rules metadata.
Exact evidence-key overlap is shared lineage context, not statistical independence or causality.
The v1 policy is intentionally incomplete rather than inferring uncalibrated relationships.
Shared task-count lineage does not establish which candidate explains an outcome.
policies.presentation_effect: retain both candidates with no winner
policies.statement: Evidence supports both policy under-use and infrastructure saturation candidates; the current report does not choose between them.

limitations: Corroboration does not increase confidence or prove policy, routing, or placement cause.
policies.presentation_effect: retain both candidates as contextual corroboration
policies.statement: R1 and R4 provide compatible candidate context around remaining aggregate capacity and uneven work distribution.

limitations: Suppression is a presentation/actionability state and never changes the target status.
policies.presentation_effect: retain target and mark it non-actionable while blocked
policies.statement: R0 explicitly blocks interpretation of this ordinary rule until its evidence readiness requirement is repaired.

retention_guarantee: Every input RuleResult remains in DiagnosticReport.results. Suppression changes only presentation/actionability metadata and never deletes, rewrites, or changes a status.
undeclared_pair_semantics: No relationship is inferred for an undeclared pair, including R3 and R5-R8 or arbitrary declarative rules.
